BiblicalUsage: Ra'yon is a thought, a mental conception — in Daniel it is the king's thoughts upon his bed. Nebuchadnezzar's thoughts came into his mind as he lay down, and God showed him what shall come to pass hereafter; and Daniel says his own thoughts troubled him after the vision of the four beasts.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God meets men in their thoughts: the king's dreams began in his own mind, and God answered them from heaven.
